candidates.core_provocation: When translation becomes instant and perfect, will people still learn another language to show love, respect, or trust? A teenager who refuses her translation device may discover that her imperfect words matter more than anything the device can say.
candidates.why_interesting: It turns language learning from a practical skill into a risky, intimate human choice.

candidates.core_provocation: A future translation system quietly edits away pauses, jokes, politeness, and uncertainty because they are difficult to translate. What happens when people realize that the system is not merely translating their words, but deciding what they are allowed to mean?
candidates.why_interesting: The danger is subtle and believable: communication becomes smoother while human meaning becomes narrower.

candidates.core_provocation: People begin speaking through real-time translation in voices that sound perfectly natural in every language, until one person notices that the system has given them a different personality in each language. Which version of a person is real—and who gets to choose?
candidates.why_interesting: It makes the future of language feel exciting and unsettling by turning translation into a question of identity.

parsed.selection_reason: This has the strongest short-story engine: a familiar, convenient technology produces a hidden loss, and a character must decide whether to expose an uncomfortable truth or preserve a world where everyone seems to understand one another. It creates tension without requiring a distant or fantastical future.
